sections.name: Read Rating
sections.title: Checks the Read rating rules
sections.what: Checks the rating system for a user's reads. A new user starts at 1200. The update size is 40 for the first 20 graded calls and 24 after that. Better reads and harder moments earn more points. Ratings never fall below a floor, and a wrong read never gains points while the best read never loses points.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code. The tests make sure the rating always moves in the right direction for any input.
sections.watch_out: Several expectations depend on the starting rating, the floor and the update sizes together, so changing one can fail many tests at once.
